Name: Flashbang
Components: V, S, M (a handful of metal powder)
Description: You throw a tiny spark at a point within range where it erupts with a bright flash and thunderous bang which can be heard 600 feet away. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 2d8 thunder damage and is blinded and deafened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t blinded or deafened. A creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 and the radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.
Sourcebook: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms
